summary: Frontend-only retest on https://badge-track-2.preview.emergentagent.com. (A) LIGHTBOX FIX VERIFIED — all previously failing mouse interactions now work: body has pointer-events:none but the portaled lightbox root computes pointerEvents='auto'; real-user click on [data-testid=lightbox-next] advances counter 1/2 -> 2/2, prev returns to 1/2, thumbnail strip (lightbox-thumb-1) jumps to 2/2, image click toggles transform scale(1) -> scale(2) without closing, download click fires a real browser download (filename 'Summer_Camp_2026-2.jpg', href data:image/jpeg;base64,...), ArrowRight/ArrowLeft navigate, Escape closes ONLY the lightbox (Snapshots dialog stays open), lightbox-close button also closes only the lightbox. No click dismisses the parent Snapshots dialog. (B) EXCEL EXPORT VERIFIED — /members [data-testid=export-excel] downloads members-2026-08-28.xlsx (18209 bytes, valid PK/zip xlsx header); /finance scoped to Kentron Chapter shows [data-testid=fin-export-excel] and downloads finance-Kentron_Chapter-2026-08-28.xlsx (valid xlsx); button is correctly disabled for a scope with 0 transactions (Arabkir Chapter) and hidden in the 'All' scope. Grep of /app/frontend/src found ZERO remaining CSV export code/buttons; 0 'CSV' buttons rendered on Members or Finance. One minor residual defect: backdrop click does not close the lightbox.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec item 'clicking the black backdrop closes only the lightbox' does NOT work. The root uses onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}, but the root's three children (header, flex-1 image area, thumb strip) tile the entire viewport, so document.elementFromPoint at every black region returns a child div (verified: 'flex-1 relative overflow-hidden...' and the thumb-strip div) — the root never becomes the event target. A real click in the black area beside the image left both lightbox and dialog open. Fix: attach the close handler to the image-area/backdrop child (checking e.target === e.currentTarget there) or add an absolutely positioned backdrop layer behind the content.

action_items: Make lightbox backdrop click close the lightbox (handler on the inner image-area container, not the root, since children cover 100% of the root).

Finance.jsx exportExcel is nearly identical to Members.jsx exportExcel; extract a shared exportToXlsx(rows, sheetName, filename) helper to avoid DRY drift.
